name: n-dx
description: An n-dx project as one graph: what the product promises, what is changing, where it lives in code, and the work that made it.

brand.name: n-dx
brand.logo: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300' role='img' aria-label='n-dx'><image width='300' height='300' href='data:image/png;base64,'/></svg>
brand.favicon: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300' role='img' aria-label='n-dx'><image width='300' height='300' href='data:image/png;base64,'/></svg>

mapProposed.expr: count(all('capability')) > 0 and every(all('area') | all('capability'), proposed == true)
mapProposed.label: The map is proposed
mapProposed.description: Every area and capability is what rex's migration plan proposes over a v1 tree: nothing is written until the PRD migrates

area.description: A part of the product, named for the job it does. Holds capabilities and constraints.
area.label: {title}

slug.description: The frozen folder name in the rex tree.

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: Drawn from rex's migration plan over a v1 tree, not yet in the PRD

capability.description: A standing requirement: what the product does, with the criteria that say when it is met.
capability.label: {title}

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: Drawn from rex's migration plan over a v1 tree, not yet in the PRD

reviewed.description: A person reviewed the current spec.

under.description: the area or capability this sits inside

dependsOn.inverse: the capabilities that need this one

realizedIn.description: the code zones changed by the work placed on this capability

openChanges.expr: count(in('amends') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted') + count(in('touches') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted')
openChanges.label: Open changes

constraint.description: A standing rule the product must keep, binding the nodes it applies to.
constraint.label: {title}

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: Drawn from rex's migration plan over a v1 tree, not yet in the PRD

appliesTo.description: the product nodes this constraint binds

change.description: A unit of intent: why something is changing, what it amends or touches, and when it is planned to ship.
change.label: {title}

level.description: What this change was on a v1 tree.

inbox.description: Waiting for a person to confirm what it targets.

lastModified.label: Last changed
lastModified.description: When rex last wrote this; the version a two-way sync agrees on.

amends.description: the product nodes this change rewrites

touches.description: the product nodes this change works on without rewriting them
touches.inverse: the changes that work on it

discoveredFrom.description: the work that surfaced this change

plannedFor.description: the release this change is planned for

shippedWith.description: the release this change shipped in
shippedWith.inverse: the changes that shipped in it

openTasks.expr: count(in('under') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted')
openTasks.label: Open tasks

task.description: A piece of a change small enough to run: the unit ndx work picks up.
task.label: {title}

lastModified.label: Last changed
lastModified.description: When rex last wrote this; the version a two-way sync agrees on.

under.description: the change or task this runs under

release.description: A version changes are planned for or shipped in, or that git tagged. Never a container: a field on the change and a tag in git, read here as a node so the plan can be drawn.
release.label: {version}

open.expr: count(in('plannedFor') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted')
open.label: Still open

zone.description: An architectural zone sourcevision found: files that belong together, with how tightly they hold and how much they lean on others.
zone.label: {name}

crosses.description: the zones this one imports from
crosses.inverse: the zones that import from it

component.description: A UI component sourcevision catalogued, standing in the zone its file belongs to.
component.label: {name}

file.description: A source file. Projected only on request: zones carry the shape of the code without them.
file.label: {path}

run.description: One agent run hench recorded: the task it worked, what it cost, and what it committed.
run.label: {taskTitle}

ranFor.description: the work this run was for
ranFor.inverse: the runs that worked on it

commit.description: A commit on main tied to the work it was for: by its N-DX-Item trailer, or by the run record that names it.
commit.label: {subject}

attribution.label: Tied by
attribution.description: How the commit was tied to its work: trailer, the N-DX-Item trailer names it; start-head, the run that made it recorded it as it ended; subject, trailer or window, hench backfill-commits read it from history.

landedFor.description: the work this commit landed for
landedFor.inverse: the commits that landed for it

realizes.description: the capabilities the work this commit landed for was placed on

blocked-change-names-blocker.title: A blocked change names what it waits for
blocked-change-names-blocker.says: {title} is blocked but names nothing it waits for.

closed-change-has-no-open-work.title: A closed change has no open work under it
closed-change-has-no-open-work.require: count(in('under') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted') == 0
closed-change-has-no-open-work.says: {title} is done but still has open work under it.

blocks.text: {count(all('change') where inbox == true)} in the Inbox, {count(all('change') where status == 'blocked')} blocked, {count(all('capability') where health == 'defective')} capabilities defective.
{sum(all('run'), tokens)} tokens across {count(all('run'))} runs; {count(all('run') where status == 'running')} running now.

home.headline: {count(all('capability') where intentStatus == 'met')} of {count(all('capability'))} capabilities met; {count(all('change') where status != 'completed' and status != 'cancelled' and status != 'deleted')} changes open.

home.text: {count(all('change') where inbox == true)} in the Inbox, {count(all('change') where status == 'blocked')} blocked, {count(all('run') where status == 'running')} running now.

show.text: The product map is proposed, not yet real. This PRD is on the v1 layout: the areas, capabilities and constraints here are what rex's migration plan proposes from its epics and features, by rules alone.

An epic is an area, a feature with completed work a capability, the work under them changes placed on them, and what the rules cannot place waits in the Inbox. Nothing is written until the PRD migrates; these nodes are read-only here.

home.empty: No areas yet: nothing in the PRD proposes one. The product map arrives when the PRD migrates to v2, or is bootstrapped from the code.
Nothing is in progress. ndx work . picks the next task.
No runs recorded yet. The first ndx work . writes one.
